propositions: workflow_ms is currently a monolithic label that masks hundreds of seconds of latency and prevents root-cause performance diagnosis

the completion workflow must be decomposed into non-overlapping named subphases (precheck/context, completion-agent, reconcile, no-LLM passthrough, unclassified-step, residual) that sum exactly to the aggregate within documented tolerance
instrumentation must perform only in-process monotonic clock reads at existing seams without adding LLM, Git, filesystem, network, or subprocess work
existing aggregate fields and backward compatibility with older sidecars must be preserved while new subphase durations are emitted
the six-file implementation uses the per-step duration_ms grouped by step_id from the completion-dispatch recorder to compute partitions with explicit residual reconciliation
